review:
A prosperity toad on a 5x5 paylines grid. Toads are reveal symbols: when the Prosperity Pot lands, every toad reveals the same thing – either wilds or Gold Coins worth 1x to 1,000x, which add together.

Toads can also reveal Coin Bags that multiply one to five Gold Coins. Two bonus modes: Toad Bonus and Golden Toad Bonus. The 7,500x max can hit in the base game too. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
